 Where to Shop the Best K-Beauty Brands: Inside Dear Seoul Mart at SM Makati
 Chuchie Ledesma
 Published November 19, 2026 10:00 AM PHT 
  | 
 Updated November 19, 2026 10:35 AM PHT 
 K-Beauty products are all over the Philippines. A trending skincare product and your bias’ fave lippie are now readily available here, but do you know exactly where to find them?
 It’s for this reason that i Face Inc.  has recently launched its K-Beauty concept store in the country called “ Dear Seoul ”, a Korean convenience store-inspired beauty destination in SM Makati. It houses seven globally in-demand and trending beauty brands such as Biodance, Dear Klairs, EQQUALBERRY, Jumiso, ilso, Arencia, and beplain. 
 Dear Seoul in SM Beauty, SM Makati What makes Dear Seoul interesting is how it brings together some of Korea’s most talked-about beauty discoveries in one convenient location. Instead of hopping from one store to another or blind-buying K-Beauty products online, you can now try and shop for them in person.
 “Dear Seoul was built with one goal: to bring the best of Korea to Watsons Philippines,” shared Angie Goyena, IFace Inc.’s Chief Commercial Officer.  “For Filipino shoppers, it means no more searching across platforms or waiting for a trip to Seoul. The products everyone is talking about are already on the shelf.” 
 ADVERTISEMENT
 What I particularly like about this curated K-Beauty concept store is that it makes discovering Korean beauty products a little less overwhelming , especially compared to shopping in the middle of bustling Myeongdong or Seongsu-dong, where you find your way through countless beauty shops while trying not to get too distracted or overwhelmed by all the freebies and promotions each store has to offer.
 And with so many new products and ingredients constantly making their way into our social media feeds, it can be difficult to know which ones are actually worth trying. Having a curated selection in one place , like Dear Seoul, makes it easier for us to test, compare, and find products that could be the answer to our skin's specific needs. 
 EQQUALBERRY Not sure where to start? Let me walk you through the brands, as each has something different to offer. Biodance is one of my favorites, if not my ultimate fave, because its products are effective in hydrating and soothing the skin. They are perfect as skin prep before makeup application, too! Meanwhile, Dear Klairs  is known for its products that help brighten dull skin, while EQQUALBERRY has the cutest (yet effective!) serums and creams for healthy-looking chok chok  skin.
 dear Klairs For those who prefer mild, everyday skincare, beplain 's mung bean line is worth checking out for its cleansing and soothing benefits, making it ideal for sensitive skin. If pore care is your main concern, ilso offers products designed to help clear pores clogged with excess sebum, dead skin, and dirt. Jumiso offers niacinamide-based formulas that help fade dark spots and even out your skin tone. And then, of course, there's the viral Arencia , which has gained attention for its Fresh Green Rice Mochi Cleanser. This multitasking product works as a facial wash, exfoliator, and wash-off mask.
 ilso So, whether you're looking to restock your favorite Korean skincare essentials or are simply curious to try the products you've been seeing all over social media, Dear Seoul is definitely a good place to start.
 Dear Seoul is available exclusively at Watsons and SM Beauty in the Philippines and online on  Lazada ,  Shopee , and  TikTok Shop . Follow  @dearseoul_ph  on TikTok and Instagram.  × ⏸ Unmute Read More :
